human_direction: Do not encode this behavior as a Bordeaux-specific feature. Free-form creative discovery, contextual suggestions, reuse of existing qualified guides and freedom to reshape the intent belong to the generic creation lifecycle of every guide module.

proof_scope.purpose: Use Bordeaux only to demonstrate that the generic module-creation contract works on a real qualified guide baseline.
must_prove: creation begins from requester free-form intent rather than a fixed theme catalog
the creative-director role can suggest a few contextual possibilities without turning them into permanent axes
existing qualified Bordeaux or cross-guide material is considered before unnecessary new generation
the requester can combine, reject or reformulate suggestions
the process converges to a concise module proposal before research or production
runtime conversational interaction is not required for the finished guide
must_not_prove_by: changing the accepted Bordeaux V1 route
regenerating Bordeaux audio merely to exercise the creation contract
